description: A lightweight HyperFrames creative workbench for assets, prompts, composition, audit gates, and iteration.
readme:
# Framepack

Framepack is a programmatic video workbench for coding agents and HyperFrames. It turns rough ideas, user assets, references, fuzzy taste words, and template choices into a professional video plan, then guides create, brief, audit, build, content graph inspection, preview, render, and iteration.

Framepack 0.6.x focuses on the project-local agentic workflow: design tokens, asset gaps, template/Catalog recommendations, semantic scene materialization, lifecycle audit gates, active intervention context, friction logs, and HyperFrames-safe HTML output.

Framepack includes a GSAP Motion Skill Registry: internal motion recipes across Hero, Text, Product, Data, Layout, Scroll Story, FLIP, and Scrubbed Sequence. They are written into COMPOSITION.md and converted by build into render-safe timeline beats.

中文: Framepack 是程式化视频工作台。它把“更高级、更动感、更商务、字更大、节奏更快”这类外行愿望，翻译成 agent 能执行、HyperFrames 能生产的专业视频方案。它管理素材、推荐模板和动效、生成可审计的导演方案、构建 HTML，并用主动介入和质检门禁减少黑屏、占位符和返工。

Quick path:

```bash
npm install framepack
npx framepack create --idea "A premium launch video" --assets ./assets --output-dir ./out --project-name launch-video
npx framepack workbench brief --project-dir ./out/launch-video
npx framepack workbench audit --phase all --project-dir ./out/launch-video --json
npx framepack build --project-dir ./out/launch-video
npx framepack workbench graph --project-dir ./out/launch-video
npx framepack preview --project-dir ./out/launch-video --open
```
